public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Erdős Problem 259

*Reference:* [erdosproblems.com/259](https://www.erdosproblems.com/259)
-/

@[expose] public section

open scoped ArithmeticFunction.Moebius

namespace Erdos259

/--
Is $\sum_{n} \mu(n)^2\frac{n}{2^n}$ irrational?

This is true, and was proved by Chen and Ruzsa.

[ChRu99] Chen, Yong-Gao and Ruzsa, Imre Z., On the irrationality of certain series. Period. Math. Hungar. (1999), 31--37.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 11, formal_proof using lean4 at "https://gist.githubusercontent.com/ster-oc/c7429943f6b3a634797dc8b2a3b01f2d/raw/8c6b5b7f08021f0aed2312542dd2e9ee7beaa6d6/Erdos259.lean"]
theorem erdos_259 : Irrational (∑' n : ℕ, (μ n) ^ 2 * n / (2 ^ n)) := by
  sorry

end Erdos259

sources_consulted: Chen–Ruzsa, On the Irrationality of Certain Series, Periodica Mathematica Hungarica 38 (1999), 31–37: publisher abstract and bibliographic record at https://link.springer.com/article/10.1023/A:1004742930674; full text was paywalled.
review.notes:
The sole declaration, Erdos259.erdos_259, faithfully states the source’s affirmative result. Lean checks confirmed that all arithmetic is in ℝ, the n=0 term vanishes, and the series is absolutely summable by comparison with ∑ n/2^n. The equivalence with summation starting at 1 was proved in /workspace/review/scratch.lean, and terms for n=0,…,12 were evaluated. The scratch file compiles successfully.

The source records PROVED (LEAN), agreeing with the metadata. The linked proof’s concluding statement is equivalent by Int.cast_pow, and its source contains no sorry or custom axioms. However, it does not compile unchanged against this checkout’s Lean/Mathlib APIs, so I did not independently re-certify that external proof. This is not a mathematical statement defect or a source-status contradiction.
